activities.description: Helicopter flies low over a city scene.
Helicopter films destruction scene, then dives in for a close-up shot as an explosion occurs.
Helicopter flies away, capturing smoke and aftermath of the explosion.
Helicopter circles back, flies close to buildings, providing various shots.
Ambulance drives by, traffic resumes on bridge, scene wraps up.
